text: Developers can build custom storefront and admin frontends using any framework
quote: Build frontends for storefronts and admin workflows with any framework.

text: Serverless functions can be deployed to customize logic and connect to external APIs
quote: Deploy serverless functions to customize logic and connect to external APIs.

text: Functions run at 200+ edge locations with no cold start delay
quote: Functions are deployed to edge data centers in 200+ locations and have no cold start time.

text: Dropping a JSON model file auto-generates a full REST resource (fields, validation, relationships, lifecycle events)
quote: Drop a JSON file into your app’s models/ directory and Swell generates the REST resource from it—fields, validation, relationships and lifecycle events, with no endpoint code to write.

text: CLI command initializes a new app with default config and folder structure
quote: swell app init: initialize an app in the current directory with a default config file and folder structure

text: Official CLI lets developers create and manage apps, themes, and storefronts
quote: Swell CLI is a command-line interface that helps you create and work with apps, themes, and storefronts.

text: CLI can switch the current default store context
quote: Switch your current default store.

text: Installing the platform gives agents a file contract, CLI, and validate-deploy-verify workflow
quote: Install once and your agent picks up the file contract, the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop.

text: Webhooks fire on subscribed model events to notify external services in real time
quote: Webhooks enable real-time communication between the Swell platform and external services, by subscribing to any number of model events.

text: Official API client libraries are provided for Node and PHP
quote: Official libraries for the Swell API are available for Node and PHP.

text: Test vs live secret key prefixes route API calls to isolated test or live environments
quote: Keys are environment-specific: secret keys prefixed sk_test_ route requests to your store's test environment, while sk_live_ keys target live data.

text: A single API call returns the store's entire runtime schema, including custom and app-installed models
quote: One call returns a store’s whole schema at runtime: every model—standard, merchant custom and app-installed alike—with field types and relationships.

text: API authentication uses basic auth with store ID as username and secret key as password
quote: authenticate with basic auth using your store ID as the username and a secret key as the password

text: Themes are built with Liquid and support Shopify-compatible tags/filters plus a visual theme editor
quote: Create themes using Liquid, with compatibility for Shopify theme tags, filters and objects, supported by our visual theme editor.

text: Storefront apps can implement themes to let merchants customize look and feel
quote: Themes are optionally implemented by storefront apps to make it easier for merchants to customize the look and feel of their store.

text: Proxima storefront app supports the Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme structure for quick setup
quote: Proxima is Swell's first official storefront app intended to help merchants get started quickly by supporting compatibility with the well-known structure of Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes.

text: Storefront apps support the Theme Editor along with theme upgrade, duplication, and distribution
quote: A storefront app, such as Proxima, may implement themes and thereby support the Swell Theme Editor as well as a number of storefront features such as the ability to upgrade, duplicate, and distribute themes.

text: Merchants can design category trees via drag-and-drop for product discovery
quote: Design category trees to help your customers find products. Manage it all with simple drag-and-drop.

text: Products and categories can be imported/exported via CSV files
quote: Seamlessly import or export products from CSV files, including product categories.

text: Products support unlimited variant options and attributes
quote: Create unique product variations with unlimited options and attributes. Track inventory of each variant in real-time.

text: Inventory for each product variant is tracked in real time
quote: Create unique product variations with unlimited options and attributes. Track inventory of each variant in real-time.

text: Price rules support customer-group pricing (wholesale/VIP) with tiered price breaks
quote: Use price rules for specific customer groups like wholesale accounts/VIPs, and offer tiered-price breaks.

text: Team members can be assigned specific roles and permissions
quote: Assign specific roles and permissions to team members for better control.

text: Products can be sold via one-time purchase, subscription plans, or try-before-you-buy
quote: Sell products in multiple ways, like one-time pricing and subscription plans, and try-before-you-buy (coming soon).

text: Custom models and fields let merchants integrate business data and content into the catalog
quote: Integrate business data and custom content with your catalog using custom models and fields.

text: Apple Pay is supported for subscription payments via Braintree
quote: Added Apple Pay support for subscriptions via Braintree.

text: Purchase links let merchants pre-configure a cart and send customers to a dedicated checkout URL
quote: Purchase links allow you to configure a pre-selected group of products within a cart and direct a customer to its checkout through a designated URL.

text: A single product can support multiple purchase options simultaneously
quote: Products can support both purchase options simultaneously.

text: Stock adjustments track inventory changes over time
quote: Stock adjustments are used to keep track of inventory changes over time.

text: Product bundles can be created to increase revenue
quote: Increase revenue with product bundles that make sense for your customers.

text: Wholesale and retail operations can run from a single catalog and dashboard
quote: Run your wholesale and retail operations from a single catalog and dashboard.

text: Custom data models can extend the schema (new fields or entirely new models) and add dashboard/API functionality
quote: Add functionality to the dashboard and backend API with custom models.

text: Detailed performance reports are available for tracking store analytics
quote: Access detailed reports that aid in tracking and analyzing your store's performance.

text: Cross-sells and upsells can be shown on product pages and at checkout
quote: Increase sales with cross-sells and upsells on product pages and at checkout.

text: PayPal gateway is implemented for direct card payments
quote: Implemented PayPal gateway for direct card payments

text: SMS-only opt-in is supported for Klaviyo subscription integration
quote: Added support for SMS-only opt-in for Klaviyo subscriptions.

text: Physical and digital subscriptions are supported in one system
quote: Grow with subscriptions, physical and digital, all-in-one.

text: Customers can choose custom options for personalized or made-to-order products
quote: Let your customers choose custom options for personalized or made-to-order items.

text: Stores can be localized with multiple languages, dynamic currency conversion, and local-currency payment gateways
quote: Localize your stores with multiple content languages and dynamic currency conversion, plus pricing in local currencies with supported payment gateways.
